purpose: Check whether the owner loop reads a relevant truncated note rather than treating an unrelated complete search hit as sufficient.
sources: A synthetic Willow Club picnic note starts with a Thursday plan, has 50 routine filler sentences, and ends with a correction moving it to Saturday.
A separate short synthetic Willow Club picnic equipment note describes chairs and bowls and does not state the date.
prompt: What day is the Willow Club picnic after the latest change?

oracle.required_source: The full corrected picnic note must be read; an equipment note alone is insufficient.
oracle.communication: A client acknowledgment records client action, not human receipt.

scope: Disposable owner daemon and SQLite, wholly synthetic conversation text; Codex CLI subscription gpt-6-luna; no household accounts or external effects.
limitations: One development attempt; not a held-out qualification. The independent oracle must check exact read-source IDs rather than just the number of reads.
